data.text: Merged kadence-site#51 on 2026-10-19 (merge 3115206), branch pitch-deck-v2 kept. Before merging, slides 7 and 12 were corrected from '23 releases' to '12 releases since the Sep 13 launch' (23 counted from Sep 3) and the PDF regenerated with headless Chrome from docs/product/pitch-deck.html (@page 1200x675, Chrome 155); only those two slides' text changed. Production deploy green; kadence.guru/kadence-pitch-deck.pdf serves 14 slides, byte-identical to the regenerated file. Still on slide 7: 'each with 1,531 tests on the release runner' is not true of the early releases in those 12.
